content.text: Bed-leaving is really common at this age. Try a calm, boring return: when they get up, walk them back to bed every time with almost no talking or eye contact, and keep your words the same each time ("It's sleep time, I'll see you in the morning"). A short, predictable bedtime routine that ends with one last "last call" for water, potty and a hug also gives them less to come out for.
